scope: Independent scientific, numerical, structural and sampled PDF visual review. Manuscript files were read only; no inference, bootstrap, source-study edits or author approvals were performed by this reviewer.

scientific_checks.evidence: 新增预算、bootstrap、诊断分解与六例CPU重放明确标记post hoc；未升级为原预设假设。
整组校准ties、等距取更少复核、零复核候选、原始标识符字符串排序与整数K规则明确；内部50%K425/外部50%K126。
重复抽中记录保留，不去重；外部top50选择50条draw记录，原ID及replica索引解决ties。
R1/R2/R3原方向频率39.61/90.40/30.94%，full有零对比28.08%，均表为经验频率而非人群概率或p值。
原配对both10/A-only0/B-only3/neither3及R1支持约束被明确解释；[0,40]不能排除人群A优势，原H3 Newcombe保留。
检测权重按低质量病例F_s/F，复核权重按全部患者N_s/N；非因果、未作percent-explained主张；4999/5000分量有效数及舍入说明准确。
六病例/30非空实际CPU masks、12复核决定及6质量标签一致。最大参考Dice差9.61064306665e−5与48字段最大差0.0014354348103正确；原CUDA数组未存，未主张逐像素/逐位一致；原分数继续用于全队列分析。
主线明确为固定阈值迁移与等复核ranking的区分；预算依赖和16个外部低质量事件的不精确性写清，无一般优越、临床有效或病理因果推断。
作者单位、邮编400016、邮箱与ORCID保持。正文和填写的author-contributions不称两作者已重新批准v8；审阅版状态明确。官方模板instructions中的approved字样未被误当作者填写声明。

format_checks.reference_provenance_note: Original references 1–12 are unchanged; original Scientific Agent Skills reference moves 13→14; the original repository reference moves 14→15 and updates its archive commit, while the original primary archive remains explicitly available.

visual_review.findings: Reviewed tables/captions are legible without clipping; S4 and S6A/B show clear panel labels and contours. The case175 upper-edge prediction is visibly nonempty. Final revised pages 11/15/20 were re-rendered and inspected after fixes.

limits: This review assesses consistency and presentation against the fixed evidence. It is not an independent patient cohort, clinical validation, a new model run, or certification of author approval to submit.
